Source: Found near active volcanoes, lava flows

Description: A chunk of semi-solid lava that radiates intense heat. Must be handled with care.

name: Bone Fragment
Source: Dropped by undead, found in graveyards
Used For: Necromantic weapons, bone armor, undead crafting
Description: A piece of bleached bone from a fallen creature. Used in necromantic rituals and crafting.

name: Shadow Dust
Source: Ground from shadow essence, found in dark places
Used For: Stealth gear, shadow weapons, darkness magic
Description: A fine, black powder that absorbs light. Used in stealth equipment and dark magic.

name: Phoenix Ash
Source: Collected from phoenix nesting sites
Used For: Rebirth potions, fire resistance, resurrection gear
Description: Ash that still glows with inner flame. Can be used to resurrect the dead.

name: Dragon Scale
Source: Shed by dragons, found in dragon lairs
Used For: Dragon armor, fire weapons, legendary gear
Description: A single scale from a dragon, hard as steel and warm to the touch. Extremely valuable.

name: Ancient Relic
Source: Found in ancient ruins, dungeons, temples
Used For: Artifact restoration, historical items, enchanting
Description: A mysterious object from a forgotten civilization. Its purpose is unknown but it radiates power.

name: Elemental Gem
Source: Found at elemental nexuses, planar intersections
Used For: Elemental summoning, elemental weapons, planar magic
Description: A gem that contains a trapped elemental spirit. Can be used to summon the element within.

name: Crystal Eye
Source: Found in beholder lairs, dropped by gaze monsters
Used For: Magic detection, anti-magic gear, seeing through illusions
Description: A crystalline eye that sees beyond the veil of illusion. Grants true sight when worn.

name: Blood Vial
Source: Drawn from powerful creatures, bought from alchemists
Used For: Blood magic, transformation potions, alchemy
Description: A small vial of blood from a powerful creature. Each type grants different abilities.

name: Frozen Tear
Source: Found at sites of great sorrow, ice temples
Used For: Ice weapons, sorrow magic, emotional gear
Description: A tear that has been frozen by magical cold. Contains immense sadness and ice power.

name: Star Fragment
Source: Found at meteor sites, celestial impact zones
Used For: Cosmic weapons, star armor, celestial gear
Description: A piece of a fallen star that still glows with celestial light. Contains cosmic power.

name: Demon Blood
Source: Drawn from slain demons, found in demonic rituals
Used For: Demonic weapons, infernal armor, corruption magic
Description: Blood from a demon that writhes and bubbles. Grants demonic power but corrupts the user.

name: Angel Feather
Source: Gifted by angels, found in celestial realms
Used For: Holy weapons, divine armor, celestial magic
Description: A pure white feather that radiates warmth and peace. Grants holy power and protection.

name: Living Wood
Source: Harvested from animated trees, druid groves
Used For: Nature weapons, druid armor, living gear
Description: Wood that is still alive and growing. Responds to nature magic and the commands of druids.

name: Void Crystal
Source: Found at void rifts, planar tears
Used For: Void weapons, entropy armor, reality-warping gear
Description: A crystal of pure void that contains absolute nothingness. Warps space around it.

name: Ancient Scroll
Source: Found in ancient libraries, wizard towers, dungeons
Used For: Spell learning, knowledge equipment, magical research
Description: A scroll written in an ancient language. Contains forgotten spells and knowledge.

name: World Tree Leaf
Source: Found beneath World Trees, in sacred groves
Used For: Life weapons, nature armor, world-healing gear
Description: A single leaf from a World Tree that never wilts. Contains the essence of all life.

name: Planar Compass
Source: Created by planar mages, found at planar crossings
Used For: Planar travel, dimensional anchors, reality navigation
Description: A compass that points toward the nearest planar rift. Essential for planar travelers.

name: Chaos Shard
Source: Found at chaos storms, wild magic zones
Used For: Chaos weapons, random-enchant gear, wild magic items
Description: A shard of pure chaos that constantly changes shape and color. Imbues items with random properties.

name: Soul Gem
Source: Created by necromancers, found in soul forges
Used For: Soul trapping, undead summoning, necromantic gear
Description: A gem designed to capture and contain souls. Can be used to bind spirits to objects.

name: Primordial Shard
Source: Found at the heart of creation, primordial planes
Used For: Creation weapons, world-building gear, god-forging artifacts
Description: A fragment from the moment of creation itself. Contains the power to create or destroy worlds.

name: Wooden Handle
Source: Carved from oak, ash, or maple logs at a crafting bench
Used For: Axes, hammers, maces, picks, spears, hoes, shovels
Description: A sturdy wooden grip shaped to fit the hand. The foundation of nearly every hafted tool and weapon.

name: Leather Scraps
Source: Leftover pieces from leatherworking, salvaged from old gear
Used For: Grips, bindings, straps, padding, small leather goods
Description: Assorted offcuts and remnants of tanned leather. Too small for armor but perfect for wrapping handles and reinforcing joints.

name: Leather Strap
Source: Cut from cured hide at a tannery
Used For: Shield straps, bag closures, armor belts, bindings
Description: A long, narrow strip of tough leather. Used to secure shield arms, fasten packs, and reinforce armor joints.

name: Leather Binding
Source: Woven from thin leather strips at a workshop
Used For: Spear grips, pickaxe handles, staff wrappings, tome bindings
Description: Tightly braided leather cord used to wrap weapon hafts and bind pages into spell tomes.

name: Chain Links
Source: Forged from iron wire at a smithy, interlinked by a chainmaker
Used For: Chain mail, flails, morning stars, armor reinforcement
Description: A bundle of interlocking metal rings. When woven together they form flexible armor, or threaded onto a weapon they become a devastating flail head.

name: Bowstring
Source: Twisted from hemp or flax fibers at a fletcher's bench
Used For: Short bows, long bows, crossbows, hand crossbows
Description: A tightly twisted cord of plant fiber with just the right tension to launch arrows with force.

name: Silk String
Source: Harvested from giant spider silk or cultivated silk worms
Used For: Composite bows, repeating crossbows, advanced ranged weapons
Description: A shimmering cord woven from rare silk. Its elasticity and strength yield superior ranged weapon performance.

name: Iron Rivet
Source: Cast from molten iron in small molds at a smithy
Used For: Sword crossguards, armor joints, shield rims, helm fittings
Description: A small flanged metal pin used to join separate pieces of equipment permanently. Unobtrusive but essential.

name: Bolt of Cloth
Source: Woven on a loom from cotton, flax, or wool
Used For: Gambesons, padding, clothing, banners, bandages
Description: A roll of tightly-woven fabric. The foundation of padded armor and the lining inside every metal suit.

name: Canvas
Source: Woven from heavy flax or hemp threads
Used For: Backpacks, tents, tarps, sailcloth, armor coverings
Description: A heavy, coarse-woven fabric prized for its durability and water resistance. The adventurer's everyday essential.

name: Padding Batting
Source: Carded wool or cotton compressed into sheets
Used For: Armor padding, gambeson lining, helmet cushions, knee guards
Description: Thick, resilient batting that absorbs impact. Worn beneath every suit of armor worth its weight.

name: Cured Hide
Source: Tanned animal skin, stretched and dried at a tannery
Used For: Hide armor, leather armor base, shield faces, bags, pouches
Description: A full sheet of chemically-treated animal hide. Tougher than rawhide and flexible enough to shape into armor.

name: Moonwater
Source: Collected from moonlit springs or distilled under a full moon by alchemists
Used For: Potion bases, elixirs, alchemical catalysts, enchantment solvents
Description: A luminous, silvery liquid that glows faintly in darkness. The universal solvent of alchemy, used as a base for most potions.

name: Griffin Feather
Source: Shed naturally by griffins during molting season, or plucked from fallen griffins
Used For: Speed potions, agility elixirs, potions of flying, wind enchantments
Description: A majestic feather from the wings of a griffin. It hums with latent wind magic and grants swiftness to any concoction it infuses.

name: Iron Dust
Source: Ground from iron ore or collected from grinding wheels at a smithy
Used For: Strength enchantments, earth essences, unbreaking enchantments, magnetic traps
Description: A fine metallic powder that retains traces of earthly strength. Used by enchanters to imbue items with durability and power.

name: Ancient Wood
Source: Harvested from ancient forests, sealed stumps in deep caves, or fallen trees in fey groves
Used For: Arcane staves, elven blades, crystal wands, rune carvings
Description: Wood so old it has turned to stone on the outside while remaining magically alive within. Revered by druids and elven craftsmen.
